# fault-injector

> Inject faults into outbound calls in tests: wrap sync or async callables with rules that raise, delay through an injected sleep or return canned values, on deterministic triggers.
> Python package `trysac-fault-injector`, import name `fault_injector`, MIT licensed, no runtime dependencies outside the Python standard library.

- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, limits and publishing notes
